title: Presentation and Q&A
description: Present with explicitly reviewed presenter ownership, audience publication permissions and moderated questions.
instructions: Guide the conversation respectfully. Never infer age, identity, consent or comprehension from media. Do not activate another participant's camera or microphone. Hosts explicitly review presenter and audience permissions at each presentation visit. A role assignment alone does not change media permissions. Narrowing disconnects affected publishers; they reconnect with devices off. Stop other resources before assigning a resource presenter.

nodes.label: Welcome
nodes.instructions: Welcome. Invite participants to contribute; time limits are advisory.

nodes.label: Presentation
nodes.instructions: Review and set the current presenter and audience microphone, camera and screen-share permissions. Assignment never starts a device. The presenter chooses when to share an approved source. Stop other resource leases before assigning a resource presenter; their owner remains unchanged.

nodes.label: Questions
nodes.instructions: Review presenter permissions for this new visit. Read the moderated Questions queue and explicitly share one question when appropriate. Offer a reviewed temporary speaker permission for a named participant only; they still choose whether to unmute. Resolve or dismiss questions explicitly. Ending this visit restores only this skill’s restrictions.

nodes.label: Close
nodes.instructions: Close. Invite participants to contribute; time limits are advisory.

nodes.label: Complete
nodes.instructions: Confirm next actions. Guidance ends; the call remains open.

title: Office hours
description: Use moderated questions and explicitly reviewed temporary speaking permissions for orderly group Q&A.
instructions: Guide the conversation respectfully. Never infer age, identity, consent or comprehension from media. Do not activate another participant's camera or microphone. Use Questions for participant submissions; nothing is shared or moderated automatically. Each presentation visit requires an explicit presenter/audience review. Temporary speaking permission never turns on a microphone, and its expiry may interrupt that publisher until a fresh scoped reconnect.

nodes.label: Question
nodes.instructions: Review the presenter and audience publication permissions, then collect questions in the moderated queue. Ask before sharing the selected question; the queue never grants speaking authority.

nodes.label: Explore together
nodes.instructions: Review permissions for this visit and choose the current presenter. If useful, review a temporary speaker assignment for a named participant for at most five minutes. The speaker decides when to unmute. Resolve the shared question explicitly; changing a presenter never transfers resource ownership or starts a device.

nodes.label: Next steps
nodes.instructions: Next steps. Invite participants to contribute; time limits are advisory.

nodes.label: Complete
nodes.instructions: Confirm next actions. Guidance ends; the call remains open.

title: Planning workshop
description: Develop options and dependencies in two parallel guidance groups, then join to choose owners and next steps.
instructions: Guide the conversation respectfully. Never infer age, identity, consent or comprehension from media. Do not activate another participant's camera or microphone. Assign an options lead and a dependency lead before starting. Parallel groups share this call; they are not private breakout rooms. Each group explicitly acknowledges its results before the host continues. No source, media effect or agent task starts automatically.

nodes.label: Agree the scope
nodes.instructions: Agree an outcome and bounds for both groups.

nodes.label: Develop options
nodes.instructions: Develop a short set of options within the agreed scope. Use only authorized resources.

nodes.label: Confirm options are ready
nodes.instructions: The assigned lead acknowledges when these options are ready to discuss.

nodes.label: Identify dependencies
nodes.instructions: List dependencies, unknowns and questions without taking external actions.

nodes.label: Confirm dependencies are ready
nodes.instructions: The assigned lead acknowledges when this group is ready to discuss.

nodes.label: Compare and choose
nodes.instructions: Both groups have joined. Compare their work and explicitly choose the next actions.

nodes.label: Owners and next steps
nodes.instructions: Agree owners and next steps. This guidance does not send messages or assign external tasks.

nodes.label: Complete
nodes.instructions: Guidance ends; the call remains open.

title: Training and role-play
description: Practice a bounded scenario for three rounds with explicit reflection and acknowledgment.
instructions: Guide the conversation respectfully. Never infer age, identity, consent or comprehension from media. Do not activate another participant's camera or microphone. Agree the scenario and roles explicitly. Three finite rounds create fresh visits and acknowledgments. Feedback is participant-led reflection, not an automated assessment. No model, message, purchase or media action is invoked by the template. Children’s Skills remain unavailable.

nodes.label: Agree the scenario
nodes.instructions: Agree a safe bounded scenario, the learning aim and how to stop. Participation and feedback remain voluntary.

nodes.label: Practice the scenario
nodes.instructions: Practice the agreed scenario. The time is advisory; finish the turn when ready.

nodes.label: Reflect together
nodes.instructions: Invite reflection on observable choices and useful alternatives. Do not treat a track, score or agent assertion as proof of comprehension.

nodes.label: Ready for the next round
nodes.instructions: The assigned participant acknowledges this round before continuing. Each round requires a fresh acknowledgment.

nodes.label: Choose a next practice goal
nodes.instructions: Summarize what participants chose to share and agree a next practice goal. No external assignment is sent.

nodes.label: Complete
nodes.instructions: Guidance ends; the call remains open.
